name: Blocks
description: Searchable, filterable listing of content blocks (knowledge base, glossary, articles). All filtering, search, and pagination happen client-side over the authored items; layouts range from card grids over compact lists to a magazine layout with one featured item.
when_to_use: Knowledge bases, glossaries, blog/article overviews with many entries the visitor should narrow down themselves. Use News for press/date-driven content; use Teaser to list records of a record type instead of hand-authored items.
capabilities: client-side full-text search over title/excerpt with configurable placeholder
category filtering via pills, tabs, or dropdowns (list variant adds a type filter + sort)
client-side pagination with configurable items per page
six layouts: card grid, compact cards, filterable list, magazine (1 featured + 4 small)
per-item image, date, read time, and read-more link

variants.description: Card grid with category filter pills. Default.
Card grid with underlined category tabs.
Compact cards (no image emphasis) with filter pills.
Row list with category + type dropdown filters and sort. Uses the types field.
Magazine layout: 1 featured item + 4 small, with filter pills.

breakpoints.mobile: Single column; filters wrap into multiple rows.
breakpoints.desktop: 3-column card grid; magazine splits featured left, small items right.

ai.prompt_summary: Blocks: searchable/filterable article listing. Settings: variant (cards-pills|cards-tabs|compact-pills|compact-tabs|list-dropdown|magazine-pills), eyebrow, headline, intro, categories (one per line), types (one per line, list-dropdown only), search_placeholder, per_page (default 9). Content in items[] (min 1): title (required), excerpt, category, type, date, read_time (minutes), image, link.
ai.content_guidelines: 6-12 items so filters and pagination are meaningful. Excerpts 1-2 sentences. 3-5 categories; every item category must appear verbatim in the categories field.

field_hints.categories: Newline-separated list driving the pill/tab/dropdown filters; values must match items[].category exactly.
field_hints.types: Newline-separated; only used by the list-dropdown variant's second filter.
field_hints.items.read_time: Whole minutes; rendered as a small meta label.
